name: swoole/library-embedded-tests
description: Installs the test tooling for running the test suite against the library embedded in the Swoole extension (swoole.enable_library=On). The main composer.json cannot be used there: its autoload rules would redeclare the functions and classes the extension already provides. Composer-only components are not packed into the extension, so Swoole\Grpc and Swoole\Debugger need their own PSR-4 rules here. The gRPC example tests also load examples/grpc/generated and examples/grpc/Etcd, which need google/protobuf. Used by the Build Swoole workflow as: COMPOSER=composer-embedded.json composer update
